definitions.ask: Should running blocks switch to a minutes format once they pass 60 seconds?

choices.label: Keep plain whole seconds ("running 547s"), matching the finished-block "547.3s" style
Show "running 9m07s" past 60 s and "running 1h02m" past an hour; finished blocks keep "547.3s"

definitions.why: Seconds is today's running format and stays consistent with settled blocks
